text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I suffered a defeat last time. As I resolve to seize victory this time around—"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, you're way too stiff.
You look like the one who's about to run.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just sit tight and watch.
...I'm gonna make this one hell of a match.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving only those words behind,
Nakayama Festa swept out of the waiting room.
